verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at an employee-facing experience. Holders get email notifications at each vesting event, grants go to employees for acceptance and signature, and the pricing page lists 'interactive offer letters', which suggests some equity-value presentation. Nothing documents a dedicated employee portal, and the stakeholder profiles and exit-scenario modeling that are described are admin-side tools. Missing for 10: documented employee portal/login, per-employee view of grants and strike price, in-portal vesting progress display, and employee-facing outcome/exit value modeling, plus any independent corroboration.
